provenance.paper_title: GraphEQA: Using 3D Semantic Scene Graphs for Real-time Embodied Question Answering

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Buffered observations are ranked with SigLIP; only the top-K images are retained and jointly supplied with the current view to the VLM planner.
The online 3DSG stores rooms, regions, objects, and frontier links; the planner traverses its hierarchy while grounding decisions in retained images.

The metric-semantic graph is incrementally updated online as the robot maps new space and adds object and frontier nodes. For GraphEQA, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of top-K task-relevant prior images.

At each step, only the top-K relevant prior images remain in the buffer and the rest are discarded. For GraphEQA, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of top-K task-relevant prior images.

derived.hybrid_relation: The VLM jointly receives the hierarchical scene graph and task-relevant source images for grounded planning.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (top-K task-relevant prior images) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
